manifest.name: Pubs
manifest.description: Microsoft's classic publishing sample database, with authors, books, publishers, stores, sales, and publisher-logo images.

source.notes: The pinned Microsoft SQL Server 2000 sample script is converted to SQLite by scripts/rebuild-source.py. Its original Microsoft 1994-2000 copyright header and the upstream repository MIT license are retained. The converter preserves all 255 INSERT statements, eleven tables, source keys and relationships, the titleview, seven ordinary equivalents of the SQL Server indexes, and eight publisher-logo GIF BLOBs. discounts and roysched have no primary key or unique index in the source; their entities omit ModelSpec keys. The generated descriptor records empty primary-key arrays but its current format does not include a unique-key inventory. Two text fields preserve the pinned source's U+FFFD replacement character in M�nchen; they are not reconstructed. Two-digit dates are normalized to ISO text; money values use SQLite numeric affinity and SQL Server collation behavior is not reproduced. The two omitted pubdate GETDATE() defaults are frozen to 2000-01-01 for reproducibility; SQL Server-only setup, triggers, and stored procedures are not part of the SQLite fixture. The build recipe validates complete logical equivalence to the committed SQLite artifact; SQLite file bytes may vary across SQLite library versions. SQLite and JSON preserve NULL values; generated CSV represents NULL as an empty field, which is indistinguishable from empty text in CSV. BLOB values in JSON and CSV are base64 encoded.

authors.au_id: The source author identifier, retained as its original hyphenated text value.
authors.zip: Postal code stored as five-character text so any leading zero is preserved.
authors.contract: Whether the author has a contract in the source sample.

titles.type: Source publication category such as business, psychology, or trad_cook.

titles.pubdate: Publication date stored as ISO date text. The source omits this value for two rows and relies on GETDATE(); the reproducible fixture freezes the column default to 2000-01-01.

sales.ord_date: Order date stored as ISO date text after converting the source's two-digit-year literals.
sales.qty: Quantity of the publication in the recorded sale row.

discounts.lowqty: Optional lower quantity bound for the discount.
discounts.highqty: Optional upper quantity bound for the discount.
discounts.discount: Discount rate as stored in the source sample.

roysched.hirange: Upper sales-range bound for this title's royalty schedule row.

pub_info.logo: Original publisher-logo GIF bytes stored as a BLOB; generated JSON and CSV exports encode BLOBs as base64.
pub_info.pr_info: Publisher information copied from the source. The GGG&G text contains the source's U+FFFD replacement character in M�nchen; it is not reconstructed.

employee.hire_date: Hire date stored as ISO date text after converting the source's two-digit-year literals.

queries.title: Titles by publisher
queries.description: List each publication with its publisher and catalogue price.
queries.sql: SELECT titles.title, publishers.pub_name, titles.price FROM titles LEFT JOIN publishers USING (pub_id) ORDER BY publishers.pub_name, titles.title;

queries.title: Books by author
queries.description: Show publications with their authors in the recorded author order.
queries.sql: SELECT titles.title, authors.au_lname, authors.au_fname, titleauthor.au_ord FROM titleauthor JOIN authors USING (au_id) JOIN titles USING (title_id) ORDER BY titles.title, titleauthor.au_ord;

queries.title: Units sold by title
queries.description: Sum the recorded sales quantities for each publication.
queries.sql: SELECT titles.title, SUM(sales.qty) AS units_sold FROM sales JOIN titles USING (title_id) GROUP BY titles.title_id ORDER BY units_sold DESC, titles.title LIMIT 10;

tables.name: publishers
tables.description: Publishing organizations, contact details, and locations.

columns.name: city
columns.description: Publisher city copied from the source. The Munich value contains the source's U+FFFD replacement character (M�nchen); it is not reconstructed.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Optional two-character state field; the source leaves it NULL for publishers without a state.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Literal source country names (France, Germany, and USA); these are not normalized ISO country codes.

tables.tableSql: CREATE TABLE "publishers" (pub_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (pub_id IN ('1389', '0736', '0877', '1622', '1756') OR pub_id GLOB '99[0-9][0-9]'), pub_name VARCHAR(40) NULL, city VARCHAR(20) NULL, state CHAR(2) NULL, country VARCHAR(30) NULL DEFAULT('USA'))

tables.name: roysched
tables.description: Royalty percentages for title sales across sales-range bands.

columns.name: lorange
columns.description: Lower sales-range bound for this title's royalty schedule row.

columns.name: hirange
columns.description: Upper sales-range bound for this title's royalty schedule row.

tables.tableSql: CREATE TABLE "roysched" (title_id CHAR(6) REFERENCES titles(title_id), lorange INT NULL, hirange INT NULL, royalty INT NULL)

tables.name: sales
tables.description: Recorded sales by store, order number, date, title, quantity, and payment terms.

columns.name: ord_date
columns.description: Order date stored as ISO date text after converting the source's two-digit-year literals.

columns.name: qty
columns.description: Quantity of the publication in the recorded sale row.

tables.tableSql: CREATE TABLE "sales" (stor_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(stor_id), ord_num VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, ord_date TEXT NOT NULL, qty INTEGER NOT NULL, payterms VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, title_id CHAR(6) NOT NULL REFERENCES titles(title_id), PRIMARY KEY (stor_id, ord_num, title_id))

tables.name: stores
tables.description: Retail stores that sell Pubs publications.

columns.name: zip
columns.description: Postal code stored as five-character text so any leading zero is preserved.

tables.tableSql: CREATE TABLE "stores" (stor_id CHAR(4) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, stor_name VARCHAR(40) NULL, stor_address VARCHAR(40) NULL, city VARCHAR(20) NULL, state CHAR(2) NULL, zip CHAR(5) NULL)

tables.name: titleauthor
tables.description: Links authors to publications and records author order and royalty percentage.
tables.tableSql: CREATE TABLE "titleauthor" (au_id CHAR(11) NOT NULL REFERENCES authors(au_id), title_id CHAR(6) NOT NULL REFERENCES titles(title_id), au_ord INTEGER NULL, royaltyper INT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (au_id, title_id))

tables.name: titles
tables.description: Books and other publications with catalogue details and list prices.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Source publication category such as business, psychology, or trad_cook.

columns.name: price
columns.description: Source MONEY value represented with SQLite numeric affinity; fixed four-decimal scale is not enforced.

columns.name: advance
columns.description: Source MONEY value represented with SQLite numeric affinity; fixed four-decimal scale is not enforced.

columns.name: pubdate
columns.description: Publication date stored as ISO date text. The source omits this value for two rows and relies on GETDATE(); the reproducible fixture freezes the column default to 2000-01-01.

tables.tableSql: CREATE TABLE "titles" (title_id CHAR(6) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, type CHAR(12) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('UNDECIDED'), pub_id CHAR(4) NULL REFERENCES publishers(pub_id), price NUMERIC NULL, advance NUMERIC NULL, royalty INT NULL, ytd_sales INT NULL, notes VARCHAR(200) NULL, pubdate TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('2000-01-01'))
